notes: Two isnads (each opened by «حدثنا» / «و حدثنا») for one saying; the saying follows the second, whose last link is the Imam who speaks inside Abdullah b. Ata's story.
The first route stops at al-Abbas b. Amir in the text; its end is not completed.
«جدي» with a name is one link: «الحسن بن علي بن عبد الله» (rule 7).
